bagPolicy.summary: Clear plastic, vinyl or PVC bags up to 12" x 6" x 12" and small clutches, wristlets or fanny packs up to 6" x 9" are allowed.
allowed: Clear plastic, vinyl or PVC tote bags up to 12" x 6" x 12"
Small clutches, wristlets or fanny packs up to 6" x 9" (need not be clear)
prohibited: Luggage, duffel bags and camping backpacks
bagPolicy.note: This is the policy for Live Nation concerts. Strollers are allowed when used for a child. Items can vary on show day. Express entry lanes are available for guests without bags.

parking.note: There is limited metered street parking near the venue. Commercial lots are available on 5th and Bainbridge Streets, which accept cash only. ParkWhiz offers additional parking options.

rideshare.note: Use the designated rideshare area in the Route 50 East Lot. Turn right immediately after entering the lot and follow signs to the curbside pickup and drop-off area.

concessions.note: Food and beverage availability at Broadview Stage at SPAC varies by event and operating setup. Review the linked official guest information before arrival.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Accessible seating can be bought online or at the Box Office. A wheelchair ramp into the amphitheater is on the north side behind the Hall of Springs Gate, and lower level seats in sections 1 to 14 need no stairs. Accessible parking is in all lots with a valid tag and ID, first come, first served.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: For SPAC-produced events, re-entry is allowed if you get a re-entry wristband from gate staff before you leave. This applies to SPAC-produced events only, so check your event page for other shows.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: The “Will Call” window is located off the Route 50 parking lot at the Main Box Office ONLY. Broadview Stage at SPAC suggest you arrive at Will Call 1-2 hours prior to the show to avoid long lines.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Gates usually open 2 hours before show time, but gate times vary by event, so check your event listing. Golf carts can help guests with disabilities get from the entrance to their seats.
